guide_intro: Version 1.0.28 — memory film (templates, face Ken Burns, resume export), language at top of Settings, Pro restore stability, plus timeline/search/graph/replay.
guide_capture_mic: Mic: your speech is saved as a memory. When signed in, AI classifies it; in guest or privacy mode, the device extracts people and places for the graph.
guide_capture_photo: Camera & gallery: add an optional memo with names and places. Multiple photos per card; only the first is AI-analyzed, extras are thumbnails only to save cost.
guide_capture_location: Location (Settings): when allowed, GPS place names (e.g. Andong Dam) are saved with memories and shown on the graph.
guide_search_ai: Signed in + Pro: ask in natural language, e.g. "What did I do in Jeju last month?" Local cards appear first; AI summary shows below.
guide_search_local: Guest, free & privacy: on-device results as photo/title/date cards. Duplicate memories appear once.
guide_search_good: Speak naturally: person, place, date. Use Clear all on filter chips to reset search.
guide_search_limit: Tip: only the current query is shown (no stacked history). Prefer "photos I took today" over just "photo".
search_requires_account: Sign in, or use guest or privacy mode, to search your memories.
guide_graph: Graph: Person or Memory lens, pinch zoom, long-press hub drag. The same photo is not shown on both hub and memory cards.
guide_graph_ai: Graph AI (Settings): when on, a one-line insight appears on the Memory lens; relationships are analyzed in the background after save. Graph and search use the graph DB first; search answers are AI-summarized only.
guide_graph_focus: Keyword focus: tap a keyword chip on Timeline, Replay, or Search to see only related memories in a clean graph view.
guide_replay: Replay tab: month sections, large+small photo mosaic with swipe, mini graph below. (Pro) Open memory film from highlights.
guide_film: Create a short film from photos via Settings or Replay. Pick a template (classic, cinematic, family, travel, portrait, album), preview, then save or share an mp4. Face-centered Ken Burns; if export is interrupted, reopen the app to resume.
guide_recall_important: When you return to a place where you saved a memory, the app can remind you even if it is closed. Follow these steps for best results.
guide_recall_step1: Turn on “Place-based recall alerts” in Settings. On Android 13+, allow notification permission too.
guide_recall_step2: Allow location in Settings, then set system location to “Allow all the time” (needed for alerts after closing the app).
guide_recall_step3: Allow location when saving voice or photo memories so GPS is attached. Memories without GPS are not used for place alerts.
guide_recall_step4: Even if the app is fully closed, Android geofencing can detect the place and notify you. A backup check also runs about every 15 minutes.
guide_recall_step5: Tap a notification to open that memory. The same place triggers at most once every 2 hours.
guide_recall_battery: Battery: on Samsung/Xiaomi set this app to Unrestricted / Don’t optimize. Force-stop can halt geofences until you open the app again.
guide_recall_limit: Note: “Force stop” in system settings halts background work until you open the app again. iOS may deliver fewer background alerts than Android.
guide_open_recall: How to set up recall alerts
guide_recall: Recall summary: push when you are within ~250 m of a saved GPS place. See “Place-based recall alerts” above for full setup.
guide_ocr_hybrid: Hybrid (recommended): cloud AI analyzes scene, people, and place. Stable and good for most photos.
guide_ocr_lowcost: Low cost: sends a smaller image to AI. Uses less of your monthly AI allowance per photo; descriptions may be simpler than hybrid.
guide_ocr_vision: AI only: always uses full AI Vision. Richest descriptions; uses the most AI allowance per photo.
guide_ocr_ondevice: On-device OCR (experimental): hybrid mode only. Reads sign/menu text on the phone to reduce cloud use for text. May crash on some devices — turn off if the app closes.
guide_ocr_quality: AI OCR quality: how sharp the image sent to AI is. Low = smaller upload, less allowance used; High = better text and detail. Low-cost mode is always Low.
guide_privacy: Privacy mode: new memories stay on this device with no cloud or AI. Search runs locally too. Good for sensitive notes or trying before sign-up. Guest mode also uses on-device storage and local search.
guide_widget: Home widget: preview your latest memory on the home screen and jump to voice capture or search.
